## Overview

Welcome to the theme showcase book for `nghiaagent-quarto-theme`.
This book demonstrates universal typography, table theming, plot inversion, and dual-column table of contents navigation.

## Typography

### Satoshi Font Hierarchy

All headers and body copy inherit the Satoshi geometric sans-serif typeface:

- `# Level 1 Header`
- `## Level 2 Header`
- `### Level 3 Header`
- Regular paragraph text with proportional tracking and clean letter spacing.

### JetBrains Mono & Inline Code Pills

Inline code references like `mtcars`, `Sepal.Length`, and strain notation `C.1.2.3.4` use shaded background pills:

```r
# Sample R code block in JetBrains Mono
summary(mtcars$mpg)
```

## Structure of This Book

- **[Chapter 1: Table Theming](01_tables.qmd)**: `gt` and `reactable` styling in light and dark modes.
- **[Chapter 2: Visualization Theming](02_visualizations.qmd)**: Static `ggplot2` figures and interactive `plotly` widgets.
